purpose: Teach: 和田/小野/阿部/内田/西村/太田/前田/永田

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 放課後、和田さんと小野さんが図書室で勉強会するって。
lines.en: So Wada and Ono are doing a study session in the library after school.
lines.style: Casual, matter-of-fact report. Quick pace, no drama. Like she's filling him in on something that happened before he arrived.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 阿部、内田、二人とも参加するんでしょ。
lines.en: Abe and Uchida are both going, right?
lines.style: Lightly curious, checking his understanding. Relaxed—not questioning, just confirming the picture. Small upward lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 西村さん、太田さんは、部活で来られない。
lines.en: Nishimura and Ota can't make it—they've got club.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with a touch of slight regret underneath. Steady pace, no complaint in the voice, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 前田が、ノートを共有してくれるって言ってた。
lines.en: Maeda said he'd share his notes with everyone.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, genuinely pleased about this small kindness. Relaxed, natural rhythm. Voice lands gently on the good news.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 永田さんは、英語のリスニング得意。
lines.en: Nagata's really good at English listening, so that'll help.
lines.style: Brightening up as she realizes the advantage. Quick, engaging finish. Slight lift of optimism—this session might actually work out.
